proved.statement: For rank-two physical shear E with no coloop, simultaneous vanishing of every projected anchored-K row is equivalent to K=E^T M E+D0 with M symmetric and D0 diagonal; hence the exact Schur residual is diagonal plus rank at most two.
For S=D+E^T T E and any physical cut I|J, the cross block N=E_I^T T E_J satisfies sigma1(N)sigma2(N)=|det T| sqrt(det(E_I E_I^T)det(E_J E_J^T)).

For the normalized squared pair-area law mu, if its iid disjointness Omega>=1/256 and det T!=0, a physical cut has sigma1 sigma2>=|det T|det(EE^T)/64, giving the full ambient essential-density bound 16[64/(|det T|det(EE^T))]^(1/8)[|det H|sigma_min(H)]^(-1/4) in the indefinite outer-hub branch.
If Omega<1/256, some literal original coordinate has whitened two-frame leverage e_h^T(EE^T)^(-1)e_h>3/5; at most three coordinates can satisfy this. A shear coloop has leverage one.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: After whitening F=(EE^T)^(-1/2)E, column leverage equals alpha_i. On max_i alpha_i<=1/2, |lambda|>=1 and r=1/64, the partner theorem gives ||g_(1/64)||_infinity<=256 for the fresh-hub transverse curved section.
